items.Name: Bloodthorn Leaves
items.Description: The bloodthorn bush is reknowned in that its thorns actually draw in the blood of the pricked creature. A side effect is that the leaves of the plant produce a minor healing effect when chewed.
PropertiesDecoded: Cure Minor Wounds (1) Cast Spell 5 Charges/Use

items.Description: Coca leaves provide a temporary boost to reflexes.
PropertiesDecoded: Cat's Grace (3) Cast Spell Single Use

items.Name: Dust of Desire
items.Description: The leaves of certain exotic plants, ground into a fine powder, are often sold as a type of love potion by foreign merchants. When blown into the face of a person, it greatly increases the attractiveness of the speaker in the eyes of the target.

items.Name: Dwarven Brew
items.Description: A stout type of beer brewed by dwarves. To humans it is commonly called 'courage in a bottle'. Elves and halflings won't go near it, and gnomes typically use it to clean out their inventions.
PropertiesDecoded: Unique Power Self Only Cast Spell Single Use

items.Name: Glowstick

items.Name: Grease-N-Go

Smurty's Grease-N-Go (tm). Great for practical jokes and quick getaways!

(90% post-consumer product)

items.Name: A Traveler's Guide to Leilon
items.Description:
Leilon is a small city located on the Sword Coast between Neverinter and Waterdeep. It is ruled by Lord Pelindar Filmyra, is a member of the Lord's Alliance, and is a firm ally of Waterdeep.

Leilon was originally started as a mining town, with rich deposits of copper, nickel, a…

items.Name: Iniarv's Tower
items.Description: A ruined fortress located on the High Road between Waterdeep and Leilon, Iniarv's Tower was destroyed in the final orc assault against the Fallen Kingdom. It's said that on the anniversary of the battle, ghostly defenders walk the battlements, waiting for allies who never come. …

items.Name: Kryptgarden Forest
items.Description: Named after Southkrypt, an abandoned dwarfhold located within it, this small forest is believed to be the second-most-powerful source of the evil that pervades the dwarven ruin, the first being the Sword Mountains lying just north. The eastern outskirts of the forest are often u…

items.Name: Lockeater
items.Description: This is a small vial of acid which can be poured on a locked door or chest to destroy the lock. Note that some doors may be resistant.
PropertiesDecoded: Unique Power Cast Spell Unlimited Uses/Day

items.Name: Map of Leilon
items.Description: This map details all of the important locations in the city of Leilon
PropertiesDecoded: Unique Power Self Only Cast Spell Unlimited Uses/Day

items.Name: Enchanted Amulet
items.Description: Under the direction of Druxus Rhym, these amulets are created by the Red Wizards of Thay and are sold in their enclaves across the realms. Cheap and easy to make, this magical protection from certain elements is a huge source of profit for the enclaves.

items.Name: Enchanted Belt
items.Description: Having felt the sting of Sundabar’s archers in too many raids, the orcs from the spine of the world were thrilled when King Obould Many-Arrows suggested that his shamans should create a belt to protect the most worthy and cunning warriors of the tribe. The contests to decide who…

items.Name: Enchanted Boots
items.Description: In the dark night of Amn, the rich and powerful protect themselves from the predations of the Shadow Thieves by constructing elaborate traps throughout their homes. To counter this, the Shadow Thieves created these boots to quicken the reactions of their top assassins and burgla…

items.Name: Enchanted Bracers
items.Description: These wristbands look like normal protective wear. The bracers grant the wearer deadly accuracy when using bows. They are likely from the armory of some disbanded elven militia.

items.Name: Enchanted Cloak
items.Description:
These cloaks of resistance are commonly found among frost giants and other Auril-worshipping creatures in the frozen North. The cloak is white and trimmed with white fur.

The wearer can withstand extremes of cold weather and magical cold damage as well.

items.Name: Enchanted Gloves
items.Description: While these magical items have been around for thousands of years, their popularity never seems to decrease. Recently, a party of adventurers out of Calimshan uncovered a vast treasure trove, filled with magical items like these. The sudden influx of magical gauntlets does not s…

items.Name: Enchanted Ring
items.Description: Once the family heirloom of an elven paladin of Tyr, this protective ring was lost with the fall of its owner in combat.

items.Name: Nocturnis Powder
items.Description: The ground root of the nocturnis plant enduces a strong lethargy in creatures, causing smaller creatures to slip into a slumber.

items.Name: Old Owl Well
items.Description: In the hills south of Conyberry is a strange location known as Old Owl Well. Several centuries ago, an outpost of Netheril was stationed here, though it's unclear if the outpost was a trading post or a watering hole. In either case, the small keep had a well that piped water fro…

items.Description: Phandalin was an important farming center located northeast of Leilon, where the Triboar Cutoff East fades into a trail.
